description: List a restaurant's menu items. Call with just restaurantId first to see the category names (and counts), then filter with category and/or query rather than reading the whole menu. Items with choices (sides, sizes, add-ons) list them under optionGroups: when ordering, pass the chosen group and choice names as selectedOptions; a group with required=true must be chosen. Unavailable items are left out. Items marked soldAheadOnly are sold only for a scheduled date (a pre-order with a time slot): they can't be ordered for immediate delivery; use list_preorder_slots to pick a time, then draft_preorder and place_preorder (pickup). Paginate with limit and offset.

category.description: Only items in this category (case-insensitive), e.g. 'drinks'

query.description: Only items whose name or description contains this text, e.g. 'burger'

name: list_menu_items
title: List menu items
